tools.name: get_account

The snippet keeps the video's own aspect ratio (16:9 when its size is unknown). Also returns the bare iframe URL, the player and share links

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Change a video's title, description, visibility (public/private), player colour or content category. Only the fields given are changed.

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Permanently delete a hosted video and its file. Irreversible: always confirm with the user first (name the video) and only then call with confirm set to true.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: How the user's videos are doing: totals (videos, views, storage), the most viewed videos, the newest uploads and a daily views series for the last N days.

tools.name: start_video_upload
tools.description: Begin uploading a new video from the user's computer. Afterward

tools.name: upload_video_from_chat
tools.description: Store a video file the user attached in this conversation as a new hosted video. tools.name: get_upload_status

tools.name: list_films
tools.description: List the user's films (On Demand: free to watch or buy/rent), most recently edited first, with optional search and status filter. Returns public film ids to use with the other film tools. Paginate with page/page_size.

tools.name: get_film
tools.description: Full details of one film: status (draft/published), how it is released (free to watch or buy/rent) and its prices, play count, metadata, main film and trailer state, credits (with credit_ids), the publish checklist and its public page link. Films cannot be embedded.

tools.name: create_film
tools.description: Create a new draft film from a title (optionally with its age_rating and content_descriptors), exactly as the Studio's add-film dialog does. The draft starts as Buy or rent with no prices, no poster and no files, and is not public until publish_film. Returns the film's id, editor link and publish ch

tools.name: update_film
tools.description: Change a film's metadata (title, short_description (30–160 characters to publish), full synopsis (at least 150 characters to publish), director and cast lines, year, original_language, genres from the fixed list, country of production, what it was shot on (capture_format, camera), student_film, film

tools.name: publish_film
tools.description: Make a film public on its film page. Refused, with the same message the film editor shows, while the publish checklist is incomplete: title, poster, a ready main film, a price only when it is Buy or rent (a free-to-watch film publishes without one), and the creator's rights confirmation. The first t

tools.name: unpublish_film
tools.description: Take a film off its public page (back to draft). Viewers who already bought or rented it keep their access.

tools.name: add_film_credit
tools.description: Add a credit (role + name) to a film's credit list, optionally linking it to a Vidreno filmmaker by username (they get a request to accept) or inviting the person by email (the invite is sent straight away; at most 60 credits per film, invites are rate-limited per day). Returns the full credit list

tools.name: remove_film_credit
tools.description: Remove one credit from a film's credit list by credit_id (from get_film). A pending invite for it stops working.

tools.name: reorder_film_credits
tools.description: Set the order of a film's credits: pass every credit_id of the film in the order they should appear.

tools.name: invite_film_credit
tools.description: Email (or re-send) the invite for a credit that carries an email address, so the person can claim it with their Vidreno account. The same limits as the app apply: a daily cap per account and no repeat email to the same address for the same film within a day. Returns the invite link too; with link_on

tools.name: update_film_credit
tools.description: Change one credit in place by credit_id: its role or name, or who it is linked to (a Vidreno username, which they are asked to accept, or an invite email, which is sent straight away; null clears). The credit keeps its id, position and, when only the role or name changes, its accepted or linked stat

tools.name: convert_legacy_credits
tools.description: Turn a film's plain director and cast text lines into credit rows (Director for the director line, Actor for each comma-separated cast name), appended after the existing credits (names that are credits already are skipped), and clear the cast line; the director line stays, because a film needs it to

tools.name: start_film_upload
tools.description: Begin uploading a film's main film or trailer from the user's computer. Files cannot be sent through this connection: the tool returns an upload_url the user opens in their browser (signed in to Vidreno) to pick the file; the upload goes straight to Vidreno's film storage (outside plan storage) and

tools.name: add_season
tools.description: Add a season to a series (a film created with kind: series), numbered after the last one, as a draft. Title and synopsis are optional ("Season N" otherwise); a buy/rent price here sells the whole season once it is published with a playable episode. Up to 50 seasons. The age rating and content descri

tools.name: update_season
tools.description: Change a season's title, synopsis, buy/rent price (US cents, minimum $1.00, null removes) or rental window. Only the fields given change; the same validation as the series editor applies. The season's poster is added in the film editor.

tools.name: remove_season
tools.description: Delete a season with all its episodes and their videos; the seasons after it are renumbered. Refused while the season or any of its episodes has been sold or is in a checkout (unpublish_season instead). Confirm with the user before calling it.

tools.name: reorder_seasons
tools.description: Set the order of a series' seasons: every season id exactly once, first to last; they are renumbered 1, 2, 3…

tools.name: publish_season
tools.description: Make a season live on the series page. Refused, with the editor's message, until the season has an episode with a playable video (the episode itself may still be a draft: publishing the season is what lets its episodes be published with publish_episode). The series itself goes public with publish_fi

tools.name: unpublish_season
tools.description: Take a season off the series page (back to draft); its episodes keep their own status and show again when the season is republished. A published series left with no watchable episode returns to draft. Buyers keep their access.

tools.name: add_episode
tools.description: Add an episode to a season, numbered after the last one, as a draft with no video. Title, synopsis, runtime and a buy/rent price for this episode alone are optional. Up to 200 per season. Then start_film_upload with asset: episode and the returned episode id for its video, and publish_episode once t

tools.name: update_episode
tools.description: Change an episode's title, synopsis, runtime, buy/rent price (US cents, minimum $1.00, null removes) or rental window. Only the fields given change; the same validation as the series editor applies. The video is replaced with start_film_upload (asset: episode), never here.

tools.name: remove_episode
tools.description: Delete an episode and its video; the episodes after it in the season are renumbered. Refused while the episode has been sold or is in a checkout (unpublish_episode instead). Confirm with the user before calling it.

tools.name: reorder_episodes
tools.description: Set the order of a season's episodes: every episode id of that season exactly once, first to last; they are renumbered 1, 2, 3… Episodes do not move between seasons.

tools.name: publish_episode
tools.description: Make an episode watchable on the series page. Refused, with the editor's message, until its video is ready (start_film_upload with asset: episode) and its season is published (publish_season). The first published, playable episode is what lets the series itself publish (publish_film).

tools.name: unpublish_episode
tools.description: Take an episode off the series page (back to draft). A published series left with no watchable episode returns to draft. Buyers keep their access.

tools.name: get_filmmaker_profile
tools.description: The user's filmmaker profile as the Profile page shows it: username (the public handle) and why it cannot go public yet, display name, bio, location, roles, website and social links, whether the profile is public and its public link, plus how many credits from other filmmakers await an answer. The a

tools.name: update_filmmaker_profile
tools.description: Change any part of the user's filmmaker profile: username, display name, bio, location, roles (up to 6, presets or custom), website, per-platform social links and whether the profile is public. Only the fields given change; the Profile page's validation, username rules and uniqueness check apply and

tools.name: list_my_credits
tools.description: Credits that other filmmakers added the user to on their films, pending first: the role and name as written, the film (id, title, status, public page) and the film owner's name. Pending ones await the user's answer (respond_to_credit); accepted ones show on the user's public profile.

tools.name: respond_to_credit
tools.description: Accept, decline or unlink a credit another filmmaker gave the user (credit_id from list_my_credits). Accepting a pending credit shows the film on the user's public profile; declining a pending one or unlinking an accepted one keeps the name on the film but removes the link to the user's account.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: What the user's Payouts page shows, read-only: lifetime and this month's earnings split into film sales and ad earnings, the balance (available to cash out, maturing inside the hold window, paid out, in flight), the payout minimum and hold period, the saved payout method in masked form, whether ad e

tools.name: list_payouts
tools.description: The user's cash-out requests, newest first: amount, status (requested, processing, paid or failed with the reason), method, masked destination, requested and paid dates. Read-only; the user requests payouts at https://vidreno.com/payouts. Paginate with page/page_size.

tools.name: list_film_sales
tools.description: The user's film orders (buy and rent), newest first, one row per order: film, purchase or rental, price before tax, the payment processor's fee (processor_fee_estimated is true until the real fee is known; it comes off the price first), Vidreno's 10% cut of what is left after that fee, paid or refun

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's own projects (crew calls on Vidreno Projects), newest first: status (draft, live or closed), visibility, role count, how many applications are waiting, and the public and Studio links. Also says whether the user can post one (the filmmaker-profile requirements and the cap on live pro

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full details of one of the user's own projects, as the Studio editor shows them: every field, the roles with pay and their application counts, the publish checklist with the tool that completes each open item, whether it can be published, previous work and the films that could be listed as previous

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new draft project exactly as the Studio's New project does: a title (optional) and whether it is public or private (invite only). The draft is not listed until publish_project. Refused with the Studio's own message when the user's filmmaker profile is not ready (a creator account with a pub

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Change a project's details (the Studio's Details tab): title, logline, description, project type, format, stage, country and city or remote-friendly, shoot dates or dates flexible, links, previous work (the user's own published films, by public id) and its visibility (public or private · invite only

tools.name: publish_project
tools.description: Publish a project: it goes live on its page and, when public, on Projects and Jobs. Refused, with the same message the Studio editor shows, while the checklist is incomplete (title, logline, description, project type, location or remote, shoot dates or dates flexible, at least one role); the answer

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Close a live project: its page stays readable with a "no longer looking for people" notice, it leaves Projects, Jobs and the sitemaps, every open role closes and pending applicants are told by e-mail. Always confirm with the user first (name the project) and only then call with confirm set to true.

tools.name: add_project_role
tools.description: Add a role the project is looking for (the Studio's Roles tab): the role name, how many people, what it involves and the pay (paid with an amount, currency and per day / flat / per hour; expenses only; unpaid; deferred / profit share). Up to 20 roles per project. Returns the project with its roles a

tools.name: update_project_role
tools.description: Change one of a project's roles: name, how many people, description, pay, or mark it filled (its pending applications close and the applicants are e-mailed) or open again. Only the fields given change; the role keeps its applications.

tools.name: remove_project_role
tools.description: Remove a role from a project. A role that already has applications cannot be removed (mark it filled with update_project_role instead), so nobody's thread disappears.

tools.name: list_project_applications
tools.description: The applications to one of the user's projects (the Studio's Applicants tab), newest first, optionally for one role: each applicant's public profile card (name, handle, roles, location, website and social links, public films), their note and links, status, the owner's next moves, and the message thr

tools.name: respond_to_application
tools.description: The owner's move on an application to one of the user's projects: shortlist, accept or decline, with an optional message posted in the thread afterwards. The applicant is e-mailed, exactly as when the owner decides in the Studio. A decision is final (accepted and declined applications cannot be move

tools.name: send_application_message
tools.description: Post a message in an application's thread as the user, whether they are the project owner or the applicant; the other side is e-mailed, as from the Studio. Returns the whole thread. Not possible once the application was withdrawn.

tools.name: search_open_roles
tools.description: Search the open roles on Vidreno Jobs (public, live projects only): by free text, department or exact role, country, remote-friendly, pay type and project type, newest projects first, paged with limit and offset (total counts every match; follow next_offset while has_more is true). Each result is th

tools.name: list_my_applications
tools.description: The applications the user has made to other people's projects (the Studio's Applications page), newest first: role, project, status, note and links, whether it can still be withdrawn, the owner's public profile card and the message thread.

tools.name: apply_to_role
tools.description: Apply to an open role as the user, with their filmmaker profile as the application (the owner sees the public profile card), an optional note and up to 3 links. The apply form's rules apply unchanged: a creator account with a public filmmaker profile, display name and at least one role; one applicat

tools.name: withdraw_application
tools.description: Withdraw one of the user's own open applications (submitted or shortlisted). The thread stays readable; a withdrawn application cannot be reopened, so confirm with the user first.

tools.name: request_film_deletion
tools.description: Request staff deletion of a sold film you own. Immediately unpublishes it. Explicitly confirm buyers and renters will lose access if approved. This does not approve the request or delete the files.

tools.name: withdraw_film_deletion_request
tools.description: Withdraw your own pending deletion request; the film stays unpublished. Cannot change a decided request.

tools.name: start_film_master_upload
tools.description: Open a browser handoff for an HDR master/trailer, stereo/5.1/Atmos file, or bonus video. Uses the ordinary film upload engine and Studio attachment checks. Uploads do not automatically publish a replacement.

tools.name: list_film_bonus
tools.description: List your bonus materials, access rules, publication state and file readiness. Archive preserves access already promised to buyers.

tools.name: create_film_bonus
tools.description: Create a draft bonus item. Use a file handoff for PDF/image assets; video files use start_film_master_upload. Scope it to the film, a season or an episode.

tools.name: update_film_bonus
tools.description: Replace a bonus item's metadata/access/publication settings. Read it first; send all fields and its revision. Published items must have a ready file. Existing buyers keep promised access.

tools.name: archive_film_bonus
tools.description: Archive a bonus item, preserving existing customers' promised access.

tools.name: reorder_film_bonus
tools.description: Reorder all bonus items. Supply every current bonus public id exactly once; a changed list is rejected.

tools.name: set_film_artwork_position
tools.description: Set or reset a device artwork focal position using the same crop rules as Studio.

tools.name: set_film_protection
tools.description: Request protected or clear film playback using Studio's protection safeguards. Applies to all episodes of a series. Never changes global DRM configuration.

tools.name: cancel_film_protection_change
tools.description: Cancel a pending protection change only while Studio allows it.

tools.name: retry_film_protection_change
tools.description: Retry a failed protection change only while Studio allows it. This cannot retry an admin-only encoding job.

tools.name: retry_film_file_check
tools.description: Recheck an uploaded main/HDR/audio file whose inspection failed or is overdue. This does not retry encoding or restart the transcoder.

tools.name: publish_film_replacement
tools.description: Explicitly put ready replacement versions live for an already-published film/series. Viewer access, copyright screening and readiness checks still apply.

tools.name: set_film_sound
tools.description: Choose stereo Auto, generated stereo or an embedded track, and intentional silence, for a feature using the supported programme flow. Does not upload or attach files.

tools.name: request_film_review
tools.description: Ask staff to manually review your held film, with a note. This does not approve, restore or moderate it.

tools.name: acknowledge_film_changes
tools.description: Confirm you addressed the current change request on your own film. Uses the exact reviewed_at from get_film_workflow; cannot reinstate a removed film.

tools.name: get_film_workflow
tools.description: Read your film's change request and deletion-request status. No admin-only review scores or diagnostics.

tools.name: start_film_file_upload
tools.description: Open a signed-in browser upload for film artwork, a season poster, an uploaded subtitle, or an existing bonus file/thumbnail. No arbitrary URL fetching. The upload uses the website's file validation and owner checks.

tools.name: start_profile_avatar_upload
tools.description: Open a signed-in browser handoff to replace your own profile avatar.

tools.name: start_project_cover_upload
tools.description: Open a signed-in browser handoff to replace a project cover you own.

tools.name: start_video_thumbnail_upload
tools.description: Open a signed-in browser handoff to replace a hosted video's thumbnail you own.

tools.name: get_file_upload_status
tools.description: Check a file handoff created for your account. Reports whether its destination has changed since the handoff; never returns stored object keys.

tools.name: list_spoken_languages
tools.description: Search the fixed language catalogue. Use returned canonical codes for filtering and metadata, not free-text names.

tools.name: get_film_languages
tools.description: Read original language codes, No dialogue, detection progress and episode inheritance. Detection is separate from video encoding.

tools.name: set_film_languages
tools.description: Choose original languages from list_spoken_languages, or No dialogue. Manual choices take precedence over detection. An episode selection overrides series inheritance.

tools.name: get_film_processing
tools.description: Read upload, encode, protection and subtitle status separately. Uploaded does not mean playable; automatic subtitles remain environment-gated.

tools.name: list_film_subtitles
tools.description: Read manual and automatic subtitle track metadata, versions, detection status and availability. Does not return cue text.

tools.name: get_subtitle_cues
tools.description: Read a bounded page of automatic subtitle cues or a saved draft. Retain source_revision and version for editing.

tools.name: edit_subtitle_cues
tools.description: Replace a bounded range of automatic subtitle cues. Reads the full track server-side and validates timing before saving; does not overwrite concurrent edits. Set draft=true to save without publishing.

tools.name: set_automatic_subtitles
tools.description: Explicitly enable, disable or generate automatic subtitles for your film/episode, only where the unfinished automatic-subtitle feature is enabled. Does not enable it for the environment.

tools.name: update_automatic_subtitle
tools.description: Enable/disable a generated track, retry a failed translation, delete a generated track, or publish its saved draft. Requires its current source revision and version. Deleting original subtitles also cancels pending translations.

tools.name: relabel_film_subtitle
tools.description: Change an uploaded subtitle track's display label. Language and kind identify its slot and are not changed.

tools.name: remove_film_subtitle
tools.description: Permanently remove an uploaded subtitle track. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: download_film_subtitle
tools.description: Return a signed-in owner download link for an uploaded or generated subtitle track. The user must open it in their authenticated browser.

tools.name: get_branding
tools.description: Read your account's hosted-player accent colour and branding banner entitlement.

tools.name: update_branding
tools.description: Set your hosted-player account default. Null clears the colour. Free accounts must show the earn banner; paid accounts may hide it.

tools.name: get_account_settings
tools.description: Read creator mode, marketing email preference and bandwidth usage. Sign-in credentials are never editable through MCP.

tools.name: update_account_settings
tools.description: Change creator mode and/or your marketing email preference. Only subscribe when the user explicitly asks. Does not change email, password, billing or payout settings.

tools.name: list_connected_apps
tools.description: Read apps connected to your account and their granted permissions. Does not disconnect apps or expose tokens.

tools.name: list_project_invites
tools.description: List invitations you sent for a project you own. Invitations grant project access, not a role.

tools.name: send_project_invite
tools.description: Invite someone to your project by handle OR email; sends the Studio invitation email. This grants project access, not a role. Only send when requested by the user.

tools.name: revoke_project_invite
tools.description: Withdraw an invitation to your project; revokes private-project access.

tools.name: list_my_project_invites
tools.description: List projects you have been invited to, including the invitation id used to accept or decline.

tools.name: respond_to_project_invite
tools.description: Accept or decline an invitation addressed to your account.

tools.name: read_project
tools.description: Read a project page you may access, including private projects you were invited to. Does not disclose owner-only applicant data.

tools.name: get_project_discussion
tools.description: Read a permitted project's discussion. Replies accompany their parent; offset pages top-level posts.

tools.name: post_project_discussion
tools.description: Post an update on your project or reply in a project you may access. Sends the same participant notifications as the website. Only post when requested.

tools.name: delete_project_post
tools.description: Delete a discussion post you are permitted to delete as creator. Deleting a parent also removes its replies.

tools.name: pin_project_post
tools.description: Pin or unpin a top-level post on a project you own. This is a project-owner feature, not admin moderation.

tools.name: report_project_post
tools.description: Report a project discussion post for staff review; does not moderate or remove it.

tools.name: set_project_notifications
tools.description: Mute or unmute your own email notifications for a project you can access.
